role.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer, Full Stack — B2B Applications

units.raw_text: Built Threadline's MVP solo over fourteen months — Next.js front end, Node.js + Postgres back end, Stripe Billing, and a Twilio-backed factory-comms layer. Closed the first ten paying customers from cold outbound and a single Hacker News Show post; first $10K MRR within seven months of launch.
units.normalized_summary: Built Threadline MVP solo over fourteen months — Next.js, Node.js, Postgres, Stripe Billing, Twilio factory-comms; closed first ten customers from cold outbound and Hacker News, hit $10K MRR in seven months

metrics.claim: first $10K MRR within seven months of launch

units.raw_text: Designed and shipped the Threadline production-tracking schema and API. Single Postgres database, multi-tenant by row-level security, with a Drizzle ORM layer and a typed REST API generated from the schema. Schema has held through three pricing-model changes and a 40x customer growth without a major rewrite.
units.normalized_summary: Designed Threadline production-tracking schema and API — single Postgres database with row-level security multi-tenancy, Drizzle ORM, typed REST API; held through three pricing-model changes and 40x customer growth

metrics.claim: schema held through 40x customer growth without a major rewrite

units.raw_text: Led the B2B pivot from D2C-brand-as-customer to factory-as-customer in early 2023. Ran 38 customer development calls in six weeks, rewrote the onboarding flow and pricing page, and re-targeted the GTM toward factory operations leads. ARR per logo doubled in the following two quarters and churn dropped from 4.1% to 1.8% monthly.
units.normalized_summary: Led Threadline B2B pivot from D2C-brand-as-customer to factory-as-customer, ran 38 customer development calls in six weeks; ARR per logo doubled, monthly churn dropped from 4.1% to 1.8%

metrics.claim: ran 38 customer development calls in six weeks

requirements.normalized_requirement: Backend language proficiency and distributed systems concepts

requirements.raw_text: Some experience with relational databases like Postgres / MySQL
Former founder, or early engineer at a startup who has built a product from scratch is a plus
requirements.normalized_requirement: Former founder or early startup engineer who built a product from scratch
